default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1228.title: Chaikin money-flow threshold cross
E-1228.hypothesis: Volume-weighted close location over a window shows whether aggressors close bars near highs or lows; when it crosses a clear positive/negative level, persistent one-sided aggression is under way and should follow.

E-1229.title: ATR trailing-band (SuperTrend) flip
E-1229.hypothesis: A close through a ratcheting ATR band means the pullback buyers/sellers who were defending the trend gave up; stop-triggered flow follows the flip.

E-1230.title: Stochastic leaving an extreme zone
E-1230.hypothesis: When the close returns from the bottom (top) zone of the recent range, the push that held it there is spent and sidelined participants resume the other way; follow the exit.

E-1231.title: TRIX direction change
E-1231.hypothesis: A triple-smoothed EMA changing slope filters noise; its turn marks a shift of the dominant flow that slower participants then chase.

E-1232.title: Force-index zero cross
E-1232.hypothesis: Price change times volume, smoothed, switches sign when the side that trades size takes over; the loser side must cover/chase in the same direction.

E-1233.title: Expanding-range same-colour run
E-1233.hypothesis: Consecutive full-body bars each wider than the last show aggression escalating; counterparties are being forced to chase or cover, so the move continues.

E-1234.title: Keltner band re-entry fade
E-1234.hypothesis: A close outside an ATR band around the EMA is a stretch; when the next bar closes back inside, the stretched side failed to attract follow-through and price reverts toward the mean.

E-1235.title: Previous-close cross after a stay
E-1235.hypothesis: Yesterday's settlement is the reference for positions carried overnight; after trading on one side for a while, a cross to the other side flips the carried positions' P&L and forces them to act.

E-1236.title: Range-edge dwell follow
E-1236.hypothesis: Closing in the top (bottom) fifth of the recent range for several bars in a row means the market is accepting prices at the extreme, not rejecting them; buyers (sellers) in control keep pushing.

E-1237.title: Ease-of-movement zero cross
E-1237.hypothesis: Price displacement per unit of volume turns positive when price moves up easily on little volume resistance (few sellers); a sign change shows resistance has vanished on one side.
